Working style: user runs 'ultracode' (Opus, Workflow orchestration) + 'explanatory' output style (brief ★ Insight notes). Keep AUTHORING and adversarial REVIEW as separate passes; ALWAYS verify each finding against real code before applying. Verify with Playwright screenshots PLUS functional MEASUREMENT (getBoundingClientRect/naturalWidth; rows fill width when lastRight==stripRight; wait out the 0.3s theme transition before reading getComputedStyle). IMAGE PIPELINE (critical): `sips` IGNORES EXIF orientation → browsers double-rotate iPhone HEIC/PNG. FIX = ImageMagick `magick SRC -auto-orient -strip -resize 'WxH>' -quality Q -interlace Plane OUT.jpg` (bakes orientation, strips EXIF, '>' = no upscale; magick+cwebp brew-installed, sips lacks webp). Crop a panoramic banner with `magick SRC -auto-orient -crop WxH+X+Y +repage -resize ...`. Set width/height to BAKED dims (verify naturalWidth in-browser) to avoid CLS; bust IMAGE cache with ?r= when re-verifying (filenames stable; ?v= only busts the HTML). Detail-dense photos (magnolia, Big Ben) need q≥82 + larger size or they look soft. Project covers via assets/projects/_gen_placeholders.py (CARDS dict; 'nodes' motif = neural net, used for ph-neuron-art). Playwright MCP browser hangs on stale profile lock → `pkill -f mcp-chrome-`; do NOT `pkill -f mcp-chrome-` while its own session is live. Assert-guarded Python bulk edits make the Edit-tool view stale → re-Read before next Edit.
